claim: Uganda's Ebola outbreak will be formally declared over on or about 27 August 2026
resolution_criteria: WHO or Uganda MoH issues a formal end-of-outbreak declaration by 5 Sept 2026

claim: The US State Department will NOT lower Uganda from Level 4 within 30 days of the outbreak being declared over
resolution_criteria: State Dept Uganda advisory still Level 4 thirty days after the WHO declaration

claim: Kenya peak-season arrivals hold up despite political rhetoric discouraging visitors
resolution_criteria: August 2026 arrivals at or above August 2025 (277|155) per Tourism Research Institute or ministry data

claim: Nairobi hotel occupancy or ADR comes under measurable pressure as ~1|500 branded rooms open in 2026
resolution_criteria: Published Nairobi occupancy or ADR for H2 2026 below the equivalent 2025 period

claim: Zanzibar branded all-inclusive supply growth pressures independent resort rate benchmarks
resolution_criteria: Evidence of independent Zanzibar resorts cutting published rates or reporting allocation loss into 2027

claim: Regional airlift into East Africa continues expanding faster than rate discipline can absorb
resolution_criteria: Net seat capacity into NBO/EBB/ZNZ/KGL up year-on-year while published lead-in rates flat or down

claim: Rwanda's 30-day DRC entry restriction will remain in force after Uganda's Ebola outbreak is declared over
resolution_criteria: Rwanda MoH notice still lists the 30-day DRC entry denial 14 days after the WHO/Uganda end-of-outbreak declaration

claim: Entebbe international arrivals fall again year-on-year in Q2 2026 following the Q1 decline of 7.9%
resolution_criteria: UCAA or Aviation Week Q2 2026 figures below Q2 2025

claim: No Kenyan court will order a halt to operations at any Maasai Mara reserve camp before the 2026 crossing season ends
resolution_criteria: No ELC or appellate order suspending operations of Ritz-Carlton Mara | Sala's Camp or Elewana Sand River reported by Business Daily or published on Kenya Law by 31 Oct 2026

claim: Uganda's 10-year tourism tax holiday will not produce a publicly announced branded hotel signing of US$10m or more before FHS Africa Kampala
resolution_criteria: No Uganda hotel investment of US$10m+ announced by Uganda Investment Authority | UTB or hospitality trade press between 25 Jul 2026 and 3 Feb 2027

claim: Tanzania's Fair Competition Commission will clear the A Squared Holding / Nawiri Group transaction without divestiture conditions
resolution_criteria: FCC issues an unconditional clearance decision on the A Squared / Nawiri merger as reported by the FCC register | TanzaniaInvest or Tanzanian business press

claim: Zanzibar's July 2026 arrivals will show year-on-year growth below 10%
resolution_criteria: Zanzibar Commission for Tourism July 2026 arrivals figure is less than 10% above July 2025's 106|108

claim: Rwanda's MICE revenue will exceed US$100m for the first time in calendar 2026
resolution_criteria: RDB 2026 Annual Report reports MICE revenue above US$100 million

claim: Glee Hotel will change hands via the administrator rather than return to Mary Wambui Mungai's control
resolution_criteria: Administrator's report or Business Daily | Khusoko reporting a completed sale | transfer or new owner of Glee Hotel Limited by 31 Mar 2027

claim: At least one further Kenyan hotel of 100+ rooms will be placed under administration or receivership by a lender before 31 Dec 2026
resolution_criteria: A gazetted Insolvency Act notice or Business Daily | Khusoko report of a 100+ room Kenyan hotel entering administration or receivership between 27 Jul and 31 Dec 2026

claim: Kenya will not cut or remove the airport passenger levy on air tickets before 31 Dec 2027
resolution_criteria: No Finance Act | gazette notice or KCAA/KAA announcement reducing or abolishing the airport passenger service levy published by 31 Dec 2027

claim: Uganda's 25-27 September park waiver will cover entry fees only — game drives | boat cruises and permits remain chargeable
resolution_criteria: UWA or Ministry of Tourism published notice confirming scope of the free-entry days as entry fees only

claim: DRC's Ebola outbreak will exceed 3|000 confirmed cases before Uganda's outbreak is declared over
resolution_criteria: ECDC Communicable Disease Threats Report or DRC INSP situation report showing cumulative confirmed cases above 3|000 dated before the WHO/Uganda end-of-outbreak declaration
evidence: DRC health authorities released updated figures on Saturday 25 July 2026 showing 3|075 confirmed Bundibugyo cases | 1|354 deaths and 556 recoveries across five provinces — above the 3|000 threshold and before any Uganda end-of-outbreak declaration. Relayed by Xinhua and Africanews | 26 July 2026.

claim: Rwanda's DRC arrivals will fall year-on-year in H2 2026 as the 30-day entry restriction bites
resolution_criteria: RDB or NISR H2 2026 / full-year 2026 arrivals data showing DRC arrivals below the H2 2025 equivalent

claim: Uganda Airlines' Boeing 737-8 MAX and 787-9 order will not deliver a first aircraft before 31 December 2027
resolution_criteria: No Uganda Airlines 737-8 or 787-9 delivery reported by the airline|Boeing|ch-aviation or Ugandan press by 31 Dec 2027

claim: DRC's confirmed Bundibugyo case count will exceed 4|000 before Uganda's Ebola outbreak is declared over
resolution_criteria: DRC health ministry|WHO AFRO or ECDC figures showing cumulative confirmed cases above 4|000 dated before any WHO/Uganda end-of-outbreak declaration

claim: No Bundibugyo vaccine will be licensed or deployed for outbreak use in DRC or Uganda before 31 December 2026 — the DRC Prime Minister's "two to four months" timeline will not hold
resolution_criteria: No WHO prequalification|emergency use listing or national regulatory approval of a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine and no ring or mass vaccination campaign reported by WHO|Africa CDC or Oxford Vaccine Group by 31 Dec 2026

claim: The US CDC will renew its DRC/Uganda/South Sudan Ebola entry restrictions again at the mid-August decision point rather than let them lapse
resolution_criteria: CDC returning-traveller guidance or Federal Register notice showing the entry restriction order extended beyond 12 August 2026
